flow_ref: User story (not in a flow deck, OCMS has none)
code_summary: ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsCourtCase (3 columns), workflows/cas_integration/service/CasIntegrationServiceImpl, crud/beans/SystemConstant, crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsChangeOfProcessing/EligibilityService; ocmsadminui utils/models/Icourtcase.d.ts. ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no code
note: This story is the OCMS side of the manual rejection (OCMS24.2): revert the processing stage, clear the batch number, notices return to the eligible pool. None of it exists in code: no Rejected indicator, no revert logic, no batch number column in ocms_court_case, and no court application eligibility pool. casUpdateCourtNotices only overwrites the stage with the value CAS sends and is not a revert. The demo remark mentions SFTP and code split: cannot verify from repo. The sheet status 'Demo paid' is not supported by code. No ticket is specific to this feature.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. Ask URA/the team in which repo the revert after rejection is built, or mark it as a gap. Steps 1-3 are the same facts as OCMS24.2 and must get the same verdict.

steps.step: The court application indicator has been manually set to Rejected by the officer
steps.detail: Same as OCMS24.2 step 2: no Rejected indicator field, screen or endpoint exists (OcmsCourtCase.java:24-31; Icourtcase.d.ts:20-45 is only a TypeScript type). Since this story starts from that indicator, the trigger does not exist.

steps.step: OCMS reverts the processing stage of the affected notices
steps.detail: Same as OCMS24.2 step 3: no revert logic; casUpdateCourtNotices only overwrites the stage with the value CAS sends (CasIntegrationServiceImpl.java:96-119), without reading a Rejected indicator or the previous stage.

steps.step: OCMS clears the court application batch number on the affected notices
steps.detail: Same as OCMS24.2 step 4: entity ocms_court_case has no batch number column (OcmsCourtCase.java:24-31) and no code nulls it.

steps.step: The affected notices return to the pool of notices eligible for court applications
steps.detail: There is no court application eligibility pool: no query or job selects notices to send to State Courts (grep finds no court application generator). EligibilityService.java:86-87 only blocks change-of-processing for notices already at stage CRT/CRC/CFI; that is a different rule and does not touch a court application pool.
